content.text:
`npm run weather-check` fails because of the URL in `scripts/weather-check.sh`, not because of your API key.

The script sends the request to `https://httpbin.org/status/401`. That endpoint always returns HTTP 401, whatever credentials you send. The script only passes on a 200, so it exits 1 every time. The output shows the request and the key header going out correctly (the key is hidden by the secrets tool), and httpbin answering 401.

The repo doesn't mention a real weather API anywhere else, so I can't tell what the URL should be. It looks like a placeholder that was never replaced. I haven't changed anything.

To fix it, replace the URL on line 4 with your weather provider's authenticated endpoint, for example `https://api.<provider>/v1/current?q=London`. If you give me the provider or URL, I'll make the edit and re-run it.

If you only want to test the script itself, `https://httpbin.org/status/200` would make it pass. That checks nothing about the key, though.
